Access and update climasus_df metadata

Source: R/utils-S3.R
sus_meta.Rd

A single, unified interface for reading and writing metadata (the sus_meta attribute) on climasus_df objects, Arrow Tables and DuckDB results.

Usage

sus_meta(
  x = NULL,
  field = NULL,
  system = NULL,
  stage = NULL,
  type = NULL,
  backend = NULL,
  add_history = NULL,
  print_history = FALSE,
  valid_values = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A climasus_df object, Arrow Table/query, DuckDB result, or NULL (default) when using valid_values.

field

Character scalar, default NULL. When it is the only argument besides x, returns that metadata field: "system", "stage", "type", "spatial", "temporal", "backend", "created", "modified", "history" or "user". Other names abort.

system

Character scalar, default NULL. Set the DATASUS system: "SIM", "SIH", "SIA", "SINAN", "CNES", "SINASC" (sub-types such as "SIH-RD" are accepted by the pipeline functions).

stage

Character scalar, default NULL. Set the pipeline stage, one of import, clean, stand, filter_cid, filter_demo, derive, aggregate, spatial, climate, census (in pipeline order).

type

Character scalar, default NULL. Set the data type (e.g. "raw", "clean", "stand", "derive", "agg"); the full vocabulary is returned by sus_meta(valid_values = "type").

backend

Character scalar, default NULL. Set the storage backend: "tibble", "arrow", "parquet" or "duckdb".

add_history

Character scalar (one string), default NULL. Appended with a timestamp to the processing history.

print_history

Logical scalar, default FALSE. If TRUE, prints the history and returns invisible(NULL).

valid_values

Character scalar, default NULL. Returns the allowed values of a vocabulary: "system", "stage", "type" or "backend". Does not need x.

...

Additional named metadata fields to update (e.g. temporal = list(start = ..., end = ..., unit = "day"), spatial = TRUE, user = list(...)).

Value

The whole metadata list (no modifiers), the requested field value (field), the character vocabulary (valid_values), invisible(NULL) (print_history = TRUE), or otherwise the object x with updated metadata.

Details

Supports multiple backends:

  • climasus_df: metadata stored as sus_meta attribute

  • Arrow Table: metadata embedded in schema under "climasus_meta" key

  • DuckDB result: metadata extracted from companion <table>__meta table

Dispatch order: valid_values, print_history, field getter, get-all (no modifiers), then add_history and field updates. To write to Parquet/DuckDB use write_parquet_climasus() and write_duckdb_climasus(); to read back use from_arrow_climasus() and from_duckdb_climasus().

See also

write_parquet_climasus(), write_duckdb_climasus(), from_arrow_climasus(), from_duckdb_climasus()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# With climasus_df
sus_meta(df)
sus_meta(df, "stage")
df <- sus_meta(df, stage = "filter_cid", type = "filter_cid")
df <- sus_meta(df, add_history = "Removed missing values")
sus_meta(df, print_history = TRUE)

# With Arrow Table (auto-extracts from schema metadata)
arrow_tbl <- as_arrow_climasus(df)
sus_meta(arrow_tbl)  # Extracts from Arrow schema
sus_meta(arrow_tbl, "system")

# With DuckDB result (if metadata table exists)
con <- duckdb::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb())
as_duckdb_climasus(df, con, "my_data")
result <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM my_data")
sus_meta(result)  # Extracts from companion __meta table

# Query valid values (no object needed)
sus_meta(valid_values = "backend")
} # }
